spark.scene: True-color view of the Hawaiian Island chain with scattered clouds over the northwestern islands and thick white clouds over and southeast of the largest southeastern island. Central waters show diffuse translucent gray-white streaks mixed with clouds but no distinct haze or plume clearly separable from ordinary cloud.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: Precursory overflows from the north vent resumed last night. Strong glow from all vents continued with intermittent spatter from the north and south vents. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts increased in August, while the summit region showed no other signs of deformation. Mauna Loa had an increase in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 87 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the August reporting period, after 57 in July. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
